## Description

Models self- and cross-excitation in order arrivals, cancellations and trades to forecast near-term flow intensity and inform quoting or short-horizon direction.

## Where it may fit

Liquid electronic order books with event clustering and high-resolution event logs.

## Vehicles

HFT, market making and order-book research funds.

## Required data

Timestamped order submissions, cancellations and executions, event types, L2 book state and venue matching rules.

## Caveats

Parameter instability, computational cost and nonstationary event rates limit portability; backtest on event streams, not only candles.
